entry.title: CC v2.1.327 — 15 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD attributionProject — names a session's billing group, for Claude apps gateways that set admin.billing_group_tag; confirmed only via this changelog entry, not yet in settings-reference.md as of the 2026-11-18 fetch
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1 env var — given its first placemat row: stops a session's first Bash command's shell start-up files from running before the command is approved; confirmed only via this changelog entry, not yet in env-vars.md
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC env var — given its first placemat row: disables auto-updates, telemetry, error reporting, release notes and other nonessential network traffic; real and already documented in env-vars.md, but missed by earlier passes
  • CHG claude mcp add-json <name> - — reads the server's JSON from stdin instead of the command line, so tokens can stay off it; not available inside a Claude Code session; noted on the existing claude mcp list/add/remove row
  • CHG claude mcp add --scope project — now stops, instead of overwriting the file, when .mcp.json lists its servers at the top level with no mcpServers key; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /tui classic — new name for /tui's non-fullscreen renderer; /tui default still works; noted on the existing row, whose visible command text was also corrected to commands.md's own /tui [default|fullscreen] form
  • CHG /install-github-app — now asks for confirmation before it changes a repository, and its repository, secret and API key steps use the standard list and keys, with shorter messages, a spinner and clearer errors; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /export — the dialog now asks before overwriting an existing file; /export <name> keeps the file instead and says to run /export; noted on the existing row
  • CHG permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories — now asks about more Bash commands in bypass and auto modes and denies some in auto mode, and refuses more that name a path under a Read or Edit deny rule, where it used to ask; noted on the existing row
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 — the billed-local-classifier fallback warning now says an upcoming release removes the fallback; each action it would have checked will be asked about or denied instead; noted on the existing row
  • CHG --worktree — the ExitWorktree tool now asks before removing a worktree that may hold unsaved work, and is refused in don't-ask mode or with nobody to answer, unless an allow rule, auto, or bypass permissions mode allows it; noted on the existing row
  • CHG claude plugin eval — now keeps its own deny rules over a plugin's permission hook, and flags calls the hook let through; noted on the existing row
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1 — now also sends an x-claude-code-managed-settings-checksum header; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /config — now notes when another setting overrides a row; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /status — gained a list of broken agent, skill, command and output style files, keybinding errors, an unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and hook matchers that never match; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.326 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST env var — given its first placemat row: adds host.name and host.id to OpenTelemetry resource attributes; off by default
  • ADD sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite — given its first placemat row: adds paths sandboxed commands can write to, beyond the default write-list; real and already documented, but missed by earlier passes
  • ADD allowedHttpHookUrls — given its first placemat row: limits which URLs HTTP hooks can target, with an empty array blocking every HTTP hook; real and already documented, but missed by earlier passes
  • ADD httpHookAllowedEnvVars — given its first placemat row: caps which env vars any HTTP hook may put into a request header, on top of each hook's own allowedEnvVars; real and already documented, but missed by earlier passes
  • ADD dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true (PermissionRequest field) — given its first placemat row: lets an approving hook or SDK host that rewrote a command's input drop it from the sandbox the original was checked under; confirmed only via this changelog entry, not yet in hooks.md as of the 2026-11-17 fetch
  • ADD claude self-hosted-runner --use-anthropic-gh false — given its first placemat row: opts out of the built-in Anthropic-run gh api that Linux and macOS runner sessions with no gh installed now get by default
  • CHG Ctrl O — also shows hidden startup notices; noted on the existing row
  • CHG disableAutoMode — terminal and VS Code sessions in organizations with the Claude Code + Cowork HIPAA configuration now also start in auto mode by default; this setting turns it off; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.325 — 7 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed — given its first placemat row: skip the permission prompt for sandboxed Bash commands; deny rules and content-scoped ask rules such as Bash(git push *) still apply
  • ADD sandbox.failIfUnavailable — given its first placemat row: exit at startup instead of running unsandboxed when the sandbox can't start; real and already documented, but missed by earlier passes
  • ADD disableRemotePreviewScripts — given its first placemat row: managed setting that turns off scripts in the desktop app's HTML previews over SSH and WSL; real and already documented, but missed by earlier passes
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS env var — given its first placemat row: overrides the context window Claude Code assumes for the active model; now also sets the window for unrecognized model IDs that start with claude-
  • CHG sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed default changed to false in v2.1.324; before that, sandboxed Bash commands ran without a permission prompt by default
  • CHG prependPlugins / appendPlugins — a remote marketplace's plugins that managed settings declare, enable and list here now count as the organization's; pluginDigests is deprecated and ignored; noted on both existing rows
  • CHG WorktreeCreate — now refuses a hook path that goes through a symlink inside the project; have the hook print the real path instead; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.323 — 14 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /logout — given its first placemat row: sign out from your Anthropic account; in a background session, now signs out every session on the computer, deletes stored MCP logins and plugin secrets, and ends the session, as in a terminal
  • ADD policyHelper / policyHelper.path / policyHelper.refreshIntervalMs / policyHelper.timeoutMs — given its first placemat row: managed setting that runs an executable at startup to compute managed settings; no longer takes environment variables from user or --settings files
  • ADD engines["claude-code"] (plugin manifest) — given its first placemat row: plugins outside this version range aren't installed, updated or loaded; install and update pick the newest version that fits
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT / CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT=1 — the context window assumed for an unrecognized model ID rose from 200K to 1M; a session on a smaller-window third-party model can now fail every turn once full, until /clear; noted on both existing rows
  • CHG MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1 — the v1 MCP client is fully removed; setting this now runs the v2 client in a compatibility mode (earlier handshake, relaxed OAuth sign-in checks) instead; noted on the existing row
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS — the maximum it accepts rose from 64,000ms to 300,000ms; noted on the existing row
  • CHG .mcp.json — a server's approval now matches its exact name; an entry approved under another spelling asks again; noted on the existing row
  • CHG PreToolUse — when a tool's permission check fails with an error after a PreToolUse hook returned allow, Claude Code now decides the call as if no hook had answered; noted on the existing row
  • CHG PermissionRequest — when a tool's permission check fails on input a PermissionRequest hook rewrote, Claude Code now asks again, or refuses the call where nobody can answer; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /security-review — now asks before Claude runs it, outside auto mode and bypass; noted on the existing row
  • CHG -w / --worktree — worktree creation now refuses checkouts whose .git folders are links or hold hard links, such as git-new-workdir layouts and cp -al copies; noted on the existing row
  • CHG claude plugin validate — type-checks a plugin's TypeScript hooks module under --strict, shows the $ nouns a mod's engine.create hook touches, and fails a mod whose engine.create hook isn't in the one accepted form; noted on the existing row
  • CHG claude plugin install <plugin> — shows a warning instead of success when the plugin's install command writes to stderr; noted on the existing row
  • CHG agentType — the subagentStatusLine setting this field belonged to was removed; subagent rows always use the default look now, and settings files that still hold the key load as before; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.322 — 1 placemat change
entry.content: • CHG /fast — added fast mode on Vertex in the global, us and eu regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.321 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD claude remote-control --settings <file> — given its first placemat row: applies a settings file to every session the server starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart claude remote-control
  • ADD claude plugin restore-set-aside — given its first placemat row: recovers a plugin's set-aside options and secrets after a managed extraKnownMarketplaces take-over from an undeclared source
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH — given its first placemat row (real since v2.1.287): controls mod hot-reload on file changes; now also covers headless sessions reloading mods in .claude/skills
  • CHG cleanupPeriodDays — also sets how long a managed extraKnownMarketplaces take-over from an undeclared source keeps the replaced marketplace's data set aside for claude plugin restore-set-aside; noted on the existing row
  • CHG .claude/skills/<name>/ — a nested .claude/skills/ folder inside ~/.claude/plugins no longer loads the way other nested skill folders do; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.319 — 13 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /tasks — given its first placemat row: view and manage background work in the current session, including subagents that have finished; also available as /bashes
  • ADD /tasks gets an "Earlier in this session" row listing finished subagents, so you can reopen one and message it even after it leaves the list or you restart; noted on the new row
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND env var — given its first placemat row: wait for an MCP task's result in an interactive session instead of backgrounding it right away
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS env var — given its first placemat row: turns off MCP tasks in the terminal entirely
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS env var — given its first placemat row: stops feature-flag fetching without turning off telemetry
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE env var — given its first placemat row: keeps a self-paced /loop scheduling a fallback wakeup after each turn
  • ADD permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting — given its first placemat row: denies a tool call that would wait on a permission prompt and continues the turn, in terminal sessions, subagents and teammates
  • CHG /claude-api — gains a latency-optimize subcommand that finds where your Claude API code makes people wait and tries faster settings against your eval; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /claude-api — managed-agents-onboard templates were updated to match the Claude Console (removed Performance tuner, renamed two, turned off web search/fetch in five); noted on the existing row
  • CHG /usage — shows spend for today, this week and this month for developers behind a Claude apps gateway with no spend limit, on a gateway running this version or later; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /loop — a self-paced run now ends when a turn finishes instead of scheduling a fallback wakeup; set CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1 to keep the old behavior; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /add-dir — registers plugin marketplaces for the new directory only once its own trust dialog is accepted; noted on the existing row
  • CHG PostToolUse hooks now run, with up to 10 seconds to finish, on tool calls that finish after a new message interrupts the turn; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.318 — 10 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /ide — given its first placemat row: manage IDE integrations and show status
  • ADD autoInstallIdeExtension — given its first placemat row: lets /ide install the IDE extension from an external terminal
  • CHG Claude Code no longer installs or updates the IDE extension on its own when started in an IDE terminal; use /ide from an outside terminal, or your editor's extensions view, instead
  • CHG switchModelsOnFlag — subagents now stop instead of switching models when set to "Ask each time"; noted on the existing row
  • CHG deniedMcpServers — a URL entry now also blocks a matching Anthropic-provided server and connectors in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /permissions — rule details, built-in rules, and the delete confirmation now use the standard dialog; Ctrl+C twice there goes back or cancels instead of quitting; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /claude-api — managed-agents-onboard now gives a new agent's built-in tools, and a quickstart template's MCP tools, the auto permission policy by default; noted on the existing row
  • ADD claude auth status / --output-format json — gained loginExpiresAt / credential_expires_at fields showing when a stored claude.ai sign-in ends; noted on the existing rows
  • ADD claude -p "q" text output gets a one-line stderr warning starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends; noted on the existing row
  • CHG claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator — its spawn-runner hook's environment now includes CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON, naming why Anthropic sent the request; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.317 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID env var — given its first placemat row: on a self-hosted runner, has a nested claude -p run inside a session share that session's ID and transcript, as earlier versions did
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT — a subagent or teammate on a different model from the main conversation now uses that model's own saved effort level or default instead of the session's, when nothing else names one; noted on the existing row
  • ADD onFailure: "block" (hook field) — now also applies to Agent SDK hook callbacks, not just command/HTTP hooks; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /plugin-authoring — once a mod you build works, now offers once to help you share it; noted on the existing row
  • ADD /schedule — now warns when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you didn't ask for, and how to remove them; noted on the existing row
  • ADD Auto mode's check now shows a notice in the main view when it has no answer for a subagent's tool call, instead of showing nothing; noted on the existing "$defaults" (autoMode) row

entry.title: CC v2.1.316 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK env var — given its first placemat row: turns off the ultrathink prompt keyword
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP env var — given its first placemat row: keeps system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for a private CA that needs one
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT env var — given its first placemat row: sets the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one
  • CHG Fast mode for Opus 4.8 is deprecated as of 2026-10-30 and removes on 2026-11-30; migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup; noted on the existing /fast [on/off] row
  • CHG An autoMode.allow list without "$defaults" no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts; noted on the existing "$defaults" (autoMode) row
  • CHG /ultrareview [PR#] — when it finds no GitHub remote, now says to create one at github.com/new instead of suggesting a gh command that gh rejects; noted on the existing row
  • FIX claude auth login/logout — where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway, a terminal run now shows the gateway sign-in instead of refusing; noted on the existing row
  • ADD /restart / /update — given its first placemat row: restarts Claude Code and resumes the session to apply an installed update; real and already documented since v2.1.288, but missed by earlier passes

entry.title: CC v2.1.314 — 11 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories setting — given its first placemat row: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories, in every permission mode
  • CHG idleCompaction — now also compacts idle 200K+ token conversations in VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab, and covers subscribers with telemetry off and Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/gateway sessions once the hour-long prompt cache is on; noted on the existing row
  • FIX FORCE_HYPERLINK=0 — =false (also no and off) now turns hyperlinks off too, instead of on; noted on the existing row
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK — the automatic model switch it pairs with now retries on another model instead of ending in a refusal when ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL, availableModels, or deniedModels leaves only an older Opus model, or none; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /claude-api — Datadog API tracing setup now sends the dd-llmobs-enabled: true header and drops an outdated macOS xattr install step; also now asks to read a Managed Agents workflow run's workflow before changing the agent; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /dataviz — now advises on y/x-axis tick label formatting thresholds and answers donut/pie chart requests with ranked bars or a segmented bar instead; noted on the existing row
  • CHG if: (hook field) — Monitor(tail *) now matches the Monitor tool's shell commands as Bash(tail *) matches Bash's, though such a hook can only block or ask on a Monitor call, not approve or rewrite it; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /ultrareview [PR#] — now checks workspace trust before running git, as claude ultrareview already did; noted on the existing row
  • FIX claude ultrareview [target] — in a CI job with a terminal, now refuses an untrusted folder at once instead of asking, when CI is set (claude remote-control does the same); noted on the existing row
  • CHG /permissions — its Recently blocked tab now refuses to approve a row you can't read in full, including one the terminal is too short to show, and its footer explains Esc; noted on the existing row
  • CHG PermissionRequest — in Cowork cloud sessions, a hook's allow of an MCP tool call now counts as no answer, so the classifier or a permission prompt decides instead; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.312 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT env var — given its first placemat row: picks the full system prompt or a shorter one with abbreviated tool descriptions; Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and Mantle now use the shorter prompt for any unrecognized model name, even one fronting Sonnet or Haiku
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK env var — given its first placemat row: turns off the automatic model switch when a safety classifier flags a request, now also for unrecognized model names
  • ADD switchModelsOnFlag setting — given its first placemat row: chooses whether a flagged request switches models automatically or pauses for you to decide
  • CHG autoCompactWindow — a subagent's window can now lower the one CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW sets, which it had no effect on before; still never raises it; noted on the existing row
  • CHG Ctrl Enter / Ctrl X Ctrl S — in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message now does the same thing as the key; noted on the existing row
  • CHG /model / /effort — a mid-task change's cache-refresh notice now says it may wait for your next message and clears once it no longer applies, and can trigger sooner while Claude is still working; noted on both existing rows

entry.title: CC v2.1.311 — 12 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD claude self-hosted-runner --hold-idle-file / --max-hold-min — given their first placemat row: keeps an idle session alive while the host still reports leftover running processes
  • ADD ultrathink prompt keyword — given its first placemat row: raises that turn to xhigh effort on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1 via Anthropic's API
  • ADD DISABLE_COMPACT env var — given its first placemat row: turns off both automatic compaction and the manual /compact command; setting it in a settings file's env block or a mod's $.env.set can now only disable compaction, never re-enable it
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_MODEL_CATALOG env var — given its first placemat row: set to off to skip loading Bedrock/Mantle/Vertex/Foundry model settings from Anthropic's signed catalog
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS env var — given its first placemat row: in -p mode, waits for claude.ai's enabled-skills list before the first query; with feature-flag fetching off, now reuses another session's list on the same machine if it's under 10 minutes old
  • CHG /model — model names and IDs now drop the [1m] suffix and its label where the suffix has no effect; the suffix is still accepted
  • CHG Ctrl D — in claude agents, also now needs two presses on an empty input to exit, matching the main prompt
  • CHG --output-format json / stream-json — DEL, C1 control and Unicode format characters inside strings are now escaped as \uXXXX; parsed values are unaffected
  • CHG claude --teleport / /teleport — now warns when a compacted cloud session loads from its last compaction, since the summarized messages aren't in the local copy
  • CHG claude purge — now says it deletes data only on this computer, not anything Anthropic stores
  • CHG /code-review — now puts the effort level argument before the target, and tells Claude to use max effort only when explicitly asked
  • ADD sshHostCommands setting — given its first placemat row: adds SSH connections to the Desktop environment selector whose host comes from running a command; real and already documented, but missed by earlier passes

entry.title: CC v2.1.310 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD cleanupPeriodDays setting — given its first placemat row: sets how many days old transcripts are kept before automatic cleanup deletes them
  • ADD askUserQuestionTimeout setting — given its first placemat row: auto-continues an unanswered question after an idle timeout instead of waiting indefinitely
  • CHG Elicitation — an MCP tool call that times out in a non-interactive session while its elicitation is unanswered now tells Claude no answer came and not to repeat the call; noted on the existing row
  • CHG monitors plugin manifest key — the Monitor tool and plugin monitors now also work on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and builds with telemetry or nonessential traffic disabled, where long foreground sleeps are blocked too; noted on the existing row
  • CHG sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces — /sandbox and the sandbox startup warning now name Ubuntu's AppArmor restriction on user namespaces and how to lift it; noted on the existing row
  • CHG permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories — auto mode's one-time prompt before the first blocked read now also says that blocking those reads makes shell commands ask for permission; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.309 — 5 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD claude ultrareview's --trust-workspace flag and the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK env var — the subcommand now requires workspace trust, asking on a terminal or exiting with Error: Workspace not trusted where it can't; the flag or env var trust a folder for CI; flag noted on the existing claude ultrareview [target] row, env var given its own row
  • ADD sandbox.excludedCommands setting — given its first placemat row: names Bash-rule-syntax command patterns that run outside the sandbox; while the sandbox is enabled but can't run, an excluded command now asks before writing to its write-list paths instead of an unsandboxed fallback, which is refused there
  • CHG /claude-api — service account keys and Workload Identity Federation tokens can now manage OpenTelemetry destinations; Managed Agents subagent teams now build on multiagent_20261001 with dynamic workflows on by default, instead of coordinator
  • CHG /dataviz — the bundled palette validator now accepts APCA as a text-contrast measure alongside WCAG 2 ratios, adds an apca(text, background) function, and says whether a label inside a colored chart fill should read white or near-black
  • CHG /rewind — sed -i edits now get the standard Bash permission prompt and run as written instead of a simulated file-edit preview, and like other Bash edits are no longer restored

entry.title: CC v2.1.307 — 4 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /claude-api api-version subcommand — migrates your code to a newer API version and repoints requests at it; noted on the existing /claude-api row
  • ADD claude self-hosted-runner --checkout-hook-timeout-min <n> CLI flag — given its first placemat row: stops a session's checkout hook after N minutes (default 30), failing its setup; 0 disables
  • CHG axScreenReader / CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER (in a settings env block) — now apply only from user, managed, or --settings settings, not project settings (since v2.1.305); noted on both existing rows
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION — the notice Claude gets once this budget is spent now also tells it not to query search engines through a browser or computer use; noted on the existing row

entry.title: CC v2.1.305 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces setting — given its first placemat row: Linux opt-in letting sandboxed commands create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman), loosening the sandbox's file protections
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS env var — given its first placemat row: sets the minimum interval CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG waits between checks of whether a usage limit already lifted
  • CHG allowedMcpServers — a managed-mcp.json stdio server using ${VAR} expansion only in env is now exempt from its filtering too (one using ${VAR} elsewhere is still filtered), noted on the existing deniedMcpServers row
  • CHG /artifacts delete confirmation — y/n no longer answer it; only 1/Enter (keep), 2 (delete), and Esc (cancel) do now
  • CHG /usage — each warning is now a one-line fix naming its source; press f to apply, and the same fixes surface in /doctor
  • CHG /remote-control — pressing w during spawn-mode setup now says the chosen mode is saved for the folder, and a later start using that saved mode says where it came from

entry.title: CC v2.1.304 — 8 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD /auto-mode-setup — given its first placemat row: drafts auto mode environment entries from your project and recent sessions for review before saving; now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, the Claude apps gateway, and telemetry-disabled sessions
  • ADD /artifacts — given its first placemat row: lists, attaches, opens, or copies the link of artifacts you own or that are shared with you; delete confirmation now uses numbered choices
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC env var — given its first placemat row: trims pre-compaction history from a long -p/SDK session's transcript file once it passes 5MB
  • ADD CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW env var — given its first placemat row: sets the auto-compact window in tokens; now accepts k/M suffixes like 200k, with a warning on out-of-range or ignored values
  • ADD /claude-api managed-agents-secure subcommand — compares a Managed Agents agent's settings against Anthropic's security guide without changing anything; real and verified via the changelog, not yet in the commands reference table
  • CHG /reload-skills — compaction now resends the full skill list automatically, so this command itself sends only new or changed skills
  • CHG -w / --worktree — asks before removing the worktree and branch at exit when HEAD is detached or on another branch, so commits aren't lost
  • CHG alwaysLoad (MCP server config) — cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits on stdio MCP servers of claude.ai-synced plugins unless this is set

entry.title: CC v2.1.302 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL env var — choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; the server-side classifier's model is unaffected
  • CHG CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0 — fork subagents (subagent_type: "fork") are now on by default in claude -p, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already were in the terminal; set to 0 to turn them off, claude mcp serve never offers them
  • CHG permissions.defaultMode — when unset, claude -p and Agent SDK sessions now start in manual mode instead on third-party providers, with telemetry off, or on a fresh install; --permission-mode auto still keeps auto
  • CHG idleCompaction — /config now has its own Idle compaction row, and the notice shown after an idle compaction says how to turn it off
  • ADD proxyAuthHelper managed setting — read from only the highest-priority admin source, alongside apiKeyHelper and the other auth-refresh helpers; real and verified but otherwise undocumented on the reference page, so marked unverified
  • ADD additionalMarketplaces — version-gated alias (v2.1.232+) of extraKnownMarketplaces, noted on its existing row alongside allowedMarketplaces's matching alias of strictKnownMarketplaces

entry.title: CC v2.1.301 — 6 placemat changes
entry.content:
• ADD CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS env var — ends an unattended CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting it out
  • ADD % vim-mode motion — jump to the matching bracket in NORMAL mode, alone or combined with d/c/y
  • ADD prependPlugins / appendPlugins settings — list an organization's mods to run before or after every mod a user installs
  • ADD worktree.location setting — choose the folder where Desktop SSH sessions create worktrees on the remote machine
  • ADD /artifact-capabilities / /artifact-diagramming / /claude-in-chrome [task] — bundled skills already documented in the commands reference, given their first placemat rows this sync
  • FIX Corrected the /fewer-permission-prompts skill row, which showed the command as /less-permission-prompts
